claim: The SDK 0.160.0 B2 review candidate passed twelve of twelve nineteen-test native loopback fixture invocations, final metadata preflight and local Claude SDK/observer checks. The earlier builder live read-only task completed despite two nested-sandbox shell failures and one MCP Transport closed failure. A separately supplied coordinator observation at the pre-B2 candidate records one successful non-nested read-only shell command. Writing dispatch is not yet qualified, and backend effort remains unobserved.
limitations: Authored loopback SSE fixtures, local Claude SDK tests and observer tests are integration/synthetic checks, not unchanged upstream suites or provider-model trials.

The pre-B2 builder live task returned the correct data while two native shell attempts failed in its enclosing Codex sandbox and a Context Mode call failed with Transport closed. A separate coordinator, outside a nested Codex sandbox, observed read-only shell success at that candidate. The repaired bytes have no new live-model run; error-free MCP transport and writing (workspace-write) dispatch remain unqualified at 0.160.0.

Plugin disabling is the selected native feature gate. Tests observe direct app-server PID termination and absence of clone directories; descendant cleanup and global non-loopback egress are not observed.
Metadata preflight submits no inference. No skill was installed in the new private home and no --require-skill was used; inherited/project catalog discovery does not qualify every skill or tool.
Requested model/Max effort and live catalog entry are observed; gateway-forwarded effort, backend model identity, complete provider usage, cost, remote cancellation and token savings remain unknown.
September 30 receipts and original observations remain historical. This refresh does not rerun the historical coding oracle, Claude callsite, Astra judge, Dagu graph or unchanged upstream SDK suite.
Exactly pinned private SDK preflight/PID attributes require review on every pin move. Stable Python SDK and experimental, unsupported-for-production app-server are separate support boundaries.

Expected ResourceWarning messages and argparse rejection output remain in private fixture logs. Long-lived SDK pools, alternative approval modes, alternate binary, credential-variable path, workspace-write live execution and scheduled Dagu acceptance remain unqualified.

Initial Ruff failure exits are retained from native task returns, but exact full output/timing was not saved. Repository validators prove declared consistency, not the truth of provider or historical claims.

Earlier checkout and alternate-index validation failures are retained as before-B2 attempts. The coordinator force-added the project skill to the real index; B2 acceptance uses that actual checkout index. Historical source archive acceptance does not replace current checkout acceptance.

If the cleanup bound expires during retained startup or close, cleanup_status is unresolved and the CLI exits nonzero. Continued deferred cleanup is observed only while the embedding event loop remains running; no post-bound standalone cleanup or remote termination guarantee is made.
